key_insight: In a small randomized trial, an oral fungal mycelia combination (FoTv) appeared safe and may lessen symptoms and inflammatory markers in mild-to-moderate COVID-19.
clinical_relevance: This is an early-stage, low-cost, at-home treatment concept that may be useful as a supportive option if validated in larger trials.
method: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase I trial
Non-hospitalized adults with mild-to-moderate COVID-19 within 96 hours of diagnosis
evidence_signal: The abstract reports high adherence, low dropout, normal safety labs overall, and exploratory symptom/CRP improvements plus reduced pseudovirus infection in vitro.
watch_item: Findings are preliminary, from a small sample and exploratory analyses, so clinical benefit and generalizability remain unproven.
paper_title: Safety, Feasibility, and Preliminary Clinical Findings of an Oral Polypore Fungi Combination with Mild-to-Moderate COVID-19: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Phase I Clinical Trial
